3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the street corner: glazed curved facade with canopy, white oval shell and layered roof edge, blue sky

json.notes: Chase Center is a near-round white oval arena: a tall white shell drum with a broad, nearly flat layered roof rising to about 38 m. The south (front) face is a full-width curved glass wall with the CHASE CENTER sign, set into the curve of the shell, and a wide white canopy projects over the entrance plaza. I will model the shell, the flattened roof, the glazed front and the canopy.

photos: photo 1: the front from the street corner, showing a curved glazed facade with a sweeping white canopy above and the oval white shell rising behind it under blue sky
photo 2: an aerial view of the oval arena with a broad, nearly flat, white-grey roof and CHASE CENTER lettering across it, the city skyline behind
photo 3: a low three-quarter view from the tram side, showing the white shell, a wide overhanging roof edge, and a canopy over the entrance with glazed walls below
